creation.prompt: Create one corrected transparent full-body Milo pose candidate. Reference 1 is canonical identity; reference 2 is the OWNER'S PRIMARY HEAD-TO-BODY PROPORTION TARGET (berry reach), reference 3 is a compatible body/proportion comparison, and reference 4 is the rejected action candidate being replaced. Correct its proportions rather than recreating its oversized-head impression. Use the berry reference's anatomical skull-to-torso, ears-to-torso, shoulder-to-hip and torso-to-leg relationships; exclude its raised arm when judging body length. Preserve that small rounded head relative to a readable lean upright torso, not a huge head above a compact stump. Preserve canonical green eyes, muzzle, grey felt wool, cream chest inset, short sturdy limbs and orange tail. Do not solve this by zooming out, scaling the whole mouse, cropping, thinning the torso further or lengthening limbs unnaturally: head and torso must remain proportionate within one character. Keep three-quarter facing screen-right with restrained perspective; no closer-to-camera enlarged head. Keep feet planted and use a modest knee bend and torso hinge to reach down. Lower the entire torso and head together instead of ballooning the head or shortening the ribcage. Keep head at compatible depth to torso; do not thrust the face toward the viewer. One hand reaches toward ground level and the other balances. No seed or ground rendered. Mouth closed with no teeth; full ears, hands, feet and entire tail comfortably inside frame. Neutral studio light. Truly transparent background, no ground plate, cast ground shadow, scenery, props, text, watermark or extra mouse. One pose only.

inputs.submitted_authority: owner-endorsed head-to-body ratio and lean anatomy; not berry pose
owner-endorsed proportions; keep same character under pose change
action requirement only; do not inherit rejected large-head/short-body proportions
